complianceClaim: Zamorin ASVS 5.0-aligned security control subset (L1/L2 High-Priority Focus)
complianceScope: Zamorin Cafe ERP — Production Cafe Operations Baseline

distinctionNotes.disclaimer: Zamorin Cafe ERP implements and verifies an authoritative subset of 24 high-priority Level 1 and Level 2 security controls aligned with the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) 5.0.0. Complete, exhaustive Level 1/Level 2/Level 3 certification is intentionally not claimed.

controls.requirement: Verify that multi-tenant boundaries are strictly enforced across organisations and cafes.
controls.rationale: Multi-tenant restaurant chains require strict tenant isolation and cafe data scoping to prevent data leakage.
controls.notes: Enforced via buildCafeFilter, applyTenantFilter, and JWT context assertion.

controls.requirement: Verify that passwords and PINs are securely hashed using modern cryptographic algorithms.
controls.rationale: Protect credentials against database exposure via memory-hard scrypt KDF and salt.
controls.notes: scrypt KDF (N=65536, r=8, p=1, 32-byte salt) with constant-time comparison.

controls.requirement: Verify that brute-force attacks against operator PINs and logins trigger automated lockout.
controls.rationale: POS till terminals in fast-paced retail must withstand online PIN brute-force attempts.
controls.notes: Exponential backoff and lockout triggered after 5 consecutive failed attempts.

controls.requirement: Verify that session tokens are stored in memory and never persisted in localStorage.
controls.rationale: Prevents token theft via XSS in web application frontends.
controls.notes: JWT tokens held in runtime closure variables; refresh tokens via HttpOnly cookies.

controls.requirement: Verify that idle operator sessions automatically lock after inactivity timeout.
controls.rationale: Unattended POS terminals must lock screen to prevent unauthorized walk-up orders.
controls.notes: 15-minute inactivity timer triggers lock state requiring re-authentication.

controls.requirement: Verify that authorization checks enforce cafe and role scoping on all protected routes.
controls.rationale: Enforces least-privilege role matrix (MASTER, OWNER, CAFE_ADMIN, CASHIER, KITCHEN).
controls.notes: Pre-handler middleware checks permission claims against required scope.

controls.requirement: Verify that IDOR attempts across peer branches return 403 Forbidden.
controls.rationale: Prevents lateral movement between different branch locations within the same group.
controls.notes: Verified via negative test harness asserting CROSS_CAFE_DENIED 403 response.

controls.requirement: Verify that all input data is strictly validated and normalized before processing.
controls.rationale: Prevents injection, payload tampering, and unhandled validation crashes.
controls.notes: Schema validators strip unexpected fields and enforce type constraints.

controls.requirement: Verify that credentials, tokens, cookies, and URIs are redacted from all logging streams.
controls.rationale: Prevents credential spill into log aggregation and monitoring facilities.
controls.notes: Deep recursive object sanitizer masks passwords, bearer tokens, and session cookies.

controls.requirement: Verify that each request receives a unique correlation identifier reflected in headers and error responses.
controls.rationale: Facilitates rapid incident triage and distributed trace correlation without revealing internal topology.
controls.notes: Generates cryptographically random UUIDv4 and injects X-Correlation-ID.

controls.requirement: Verify that zero raw cardholder data (PAN, CVV, PIN) is stored or processed by the application.
controls.rationale: PCI-DSS compliance requires complete exclusion of primary account numbers and verification codes.
controls.notes: Bill model strictly lacks cardholder fields; only stores external gateway reference.

controls.requirement: Verify that sensitive customer PII is masked and access is audited.
controls.rationale: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 compliance requires masking customer phone numbers and identifiers.
controls.notes: Customer phone numbers displayed as +91 XXXXX 12345 in non-elevated views.

controls.requirement: Verify that TLS/HTTPS is enforced for all client-to-server and inter-service communications.
controls.rationale: Prevents eavesdropping and man-in-the-middle attacks on network traffic.
controls.notes: HSTS preload headers with max-age=31536000 enforced in production.

controls.requirement: Verify that dependencies are scanned for known vulnerabilities and audited continuously.
controls.rationale: Mitigates software supply chain risks through automated scanning and SBOM generation.
controls.notes: Audits npm dependencies and verifies zero critical/high CVEs before release freeze.

controls.requirement: Verify that settled bills cannot be resubmitted or double-paid (atomic transition guard).
controls.rationale: Prevents financial discrepancy, double accounting, and race condition fraud.
controls.notes: MongoDB atomic findOneAndUpdate with status: 'DRAFT'/'UNPAID' precondition.

controls.requirement: Verify that cash reversals cannot be submitted redundantly (atomic reversal guard).
controls.rationale: Ensures cash book drawer ledger atomicity and prevents balance tampering.
controls.notes: Enforces single reversal per transaction with idempotency tokens.

controls.requirement: Verify that request payload sizes are capped to prevent denial-of-service memory exhaustion.
controls.rationale: Guards Node.js event loop against heap exhaustion attacks via oversized JSON or multipart payloads.
controls.notes: 10MB body limit for standard endpoints; 15MB hard limit with disk staging for documents.

controls.requirement: Verify that API rate limiting protects critical endpoints from abusive automation.
controls.rationale: Prevents credential stuffing, DDoS, and API resource depletion.
controls.notes: Express-rate-limit configured with trust proxy client IP extraction.

controls.requirement: Verify that process health (/health) and dependency readiness (/readiness) probes are separated and unauthenticated.
controls.rationale: Enables Kubernetes / container orchestrators to probe liveness without leaking tokens.
controls.notes: /health returns fast process uptime; /readiness evaluates database connection.

controls.requirement: Verify that health probes do not expose secrets, credentials, or internal topology.
controls.rationale: Prevents reconnaissance by unauthenticated parties inspecting probe endpoints.
controls.notes: Outputs only boolean status indicators; connection strings and server IPs redacted.

controls.requirement: Verify that environment variables are validated at startup without echoing secrets.
controls.rationale: Fails fast if critical secrets are missing while preventing secret leakage into stdout logs.
controls.notes: Validates 8 core parameters, displaying boolean pass/fail indicators without values.

controls.requirement: Verify that security headers (Helmet, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options) are applied to all responses.
controls.rationale: Mitigates clickjacking, MIME-sniffing attacks, and unauthorized resource framing.
controls.notes: Enforced globally via helmet middleware.

controls.requirement: Verify that device trust status is validated upon every operator interaction.
controls.rationale: Ensures stolen session cookies or cloned browsers cannot access POS without registered device trust.
controls.notes: Inspects cryptographic device fingerprint against active registry.

controls.requirement: Verify that remote device revocation immediately terminates all active and locked operator sessions.
controls.rationale: Permits immediate containment when a physical tablet or till is lost or compromised.
controls.notes: Sets device status to REVOKED, terminating all linked session versions.
